core_judgment_rationale: Runtime-deployable joint adaptive rate (subcarrier K-QAM constellation size K in {4,8,16,32,64,128}) + transmit power (discrete EDFA gains) selection per equal-duration channel state, driven by predicted CSI; condition = LEO-satellite-to-UAV FSO link with weak-turbulence lognormal scintillation (Rytov variance) + Beckmann pointing error + outdated feedback CSI (LEO feedback delay several ms > coherence time <1ms) overcome by ESN multi-step channel prediction; objective = minimize avg TX power under rate/outage/BER constraints + maximize energy efficiency. Not classification, not AO, not fixed-scheme comparison, not post-hoc. Enters AMC M-C-A as a direct family-A (delayed-CSI/predictive rate+power) competitor.
